data_scope: NIFTY options EOD OI by expiry and strike
method: Support ranks by Put OI then Put change in OI; resistance ranks by Call OI then Call change in OI. Max Pain minimizes aggregate intrinsic-value payout over observed strikes using reported OI.
limitations: EOD snapshot only; not live option-chain movement or intraday order flow.
OI concentrations are zones, not guaranteed support/resistance.
Max Pain is descriptive, not a price forecast.
Only observed strikes are considered; missing strikes are not interpolated.
No prediction accuracy is claimed without historical walk-forward validation.
